ja:
Sound out prominently.
(Note)
I personally wonder whether this might be a misprint for 'verklingend' ('gradually becoming softer and dying away'), but many editions print "vorklingend". Some editions also give the Italian instruction fa risaltare il suono ('make the sound stand out'), which adds to the confusion. However, this appears simply to be a literal translation of "vorklingend". In the International Gustav Mahler Society's catalogue, N_FG_14.pdf is registered as a 'working copy for the collected edition': a 1967 Weinberger score with corrections entered by Karl Heinz Füssl and Zoltan Roman. On the relevant page, the vowel in vorklingend is corrected in red, and fa risaltare il suono underneath it is crossed out.
en:

(Note)
I personally wonder whether this might be a misprint for 'verklingend' ('gradually becoming softer and dying away'), but many editions print "vorklingend". However, this appears simply to be a literal translation of "vorklingend". In the International Gustav Mahler Society's catalogue, N_FG_14.pdf is registered as a 'working copy for the collected edition': a 1967 Weinberger score with corrections entered by Karl Heinz Füssl and Zoltan Roman. On the relevant page, the vowel in vorklingend is corrected in red, and fa risaltare il suono underneath it is crossed out.
